description: This file defines the AM_ProjectTemplatesController class, which manages project templates, project creation, task management, and Gantt chart rendering within the SuiteCRM project. It includes multiple actions for creating projects and tasks, generating Gantt charts, updating task order, and retrieving task predecessors, indicating its role as a core controller for project template operations.

classes.name: AM_ProjectTemplatesController
classes.description: Controller class for managing project templates, including project creation, task handling, and Gantt chart interactions within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_view_GanttChart
methods.description: Sets the view to display the Gantt chart.

methods.name: action_create_project
methods.description: Handles creation of a new project from a template, copying resources and tasks, and setting start and end dates based on user input and business hours.

methods.name: action_generate_chart
methods.description: Generates and displays a Gantt chart for the specified project template, including loading necessary scripts and rendering the chart with tasks.

methods.name: action_update_GanttChart
methods.description: Updates or creates a project task based on POST data, calculating start and end dates within business hours.

methods.name: action_delete_task
methods.description: Marks a task as deleted in the database.

methods.name: action_get_end_date
methods.description: Calculates and returns the end date of a task considering lag and business hours, for use in AJAX calls.

methods.name: action_update_order
methods.description: Updates the order of tasks based on a JSON array received via POST.

methods.name: action_get_predecessors
methods.description: Returns HTML option elements for predecessor tasks in a project, for populating dropdowns.

methods.name: create_task
methods.description: Creates a new task in the database and links it to the project template.

methods.name: update_task
methods.description: Updates an existing task's properties with new data.

methods.name: IsNullOrEmptyString
methods.description: Helper method to check if a string is null, empty, or only whitespace.
